description: This file defines a Flutter widget `TransactionsListScreen` that displays a list of financial transactions for a particular month. It includes UI components such as a month picker bar, a list of transactions with icons and amounts, and navigation to add or edit transactions. The widget interacts with a `TransactionProvider` for state management.

classes.name: TransactionsListScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that displays a list of transactions for a selected month and provides navigation to add/edit transactions.

classes.name: _MonthPickerBar
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a month picker interface with left/right navigation buttons.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state, triggers loading of transaction data.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI, displaying the month picker and list of transactions.

methods.name: onPressed
methods.description: Handles the navigation to the transaction insert/edit screen when a transaction is tapped or the add button is pressed.
